# Learning Streak Card

> A single SVG card (900x124) showing a learning streak, experience points and account age (Duolingo), or rating, best rating and games (Chess.com), or numbers typed by hand (manual). A GitHub Action builds it inside your own repository and commits it; the README embeds the committed file with an <img> tag. No server, no token, no dependency (Node 18+). Licence: AGPL-3.0.

Key facts:
- Providers: duolingo (unofficial public profile endpoint, use at own risk), chesscom (official public API), manual (local JSON file).
- Themes: dark, light, funky-dark, funky-light. Languages: en, fr.
- A value the source does not give is shown as "—", never as 0. Account age is not study time.
- If the source is down, the last valid values are kept (stored inside the SVG) with a visible "Source unreachable" notice.
- There is no hosted URL option in v0.1 (studied, rejected: docs/cloudflare-study.md).
